verses.text: OG Adam, then Sheth, then Enosh,
Kenan, Mahalaleel, Jered,
Henoch, Methuselah, Lamech,
Noah, then the trio: Shem, Ham, Japheth.
Japheth’s bloodline; Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, Tiras.
Gomer’s squad; Ashchenaz, Riphath, Togarmah.
Javan’s crew; Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, Dodanim.
Ham’s fam; Cush, Mizraim, Put, Canaan.
Cush dropped: Seba, Havilah, Sabta, Raamah, Sabtecha. Raamah’s sons; Sheba, Dedan.
Cush had Nimrod: bro started wildin’—first to go beast mode on earth.
Mizraim’s line; Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naphtuhim,
Pathrusim, Casluhim, Philistines popped out them, Caphtorim.
Canaan’s sons; Zidon firstborn, Heth,
Jebusite, Amorite, Girgashite,
Hivite, Arkite, Sinite,
Arvadite, Zemarite, Hamathite.
Shem’s line; Elam, Asshur, Arphaxad, Lud, Aram, Uz, Hul, Gether, Meshech.
Arphaxad had Shelah, Shelah had Eber.
Eber had two: Peleg—world split when he dropped; Joktan his bro.
Joktan’s fam; Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,
Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,
Ebal, Abimael, Sheba,
Ophir, Havilah, Jobab. All Joktan’s gang.
Shem, Arphaxad, Shelah,
Eber, Peleg, Reu,
Serug, Nahor, Terah,
Abram; same dude, Abraham.
Abraham’s sons; Isaac, Ishmael.
Ishmael’s line: firstborn Nebaioth, then Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
Mishma, Dumah, Massa, Hadad, Tema,
Jetur, Naphish, Kedemah. That’s Ishmael’s full drop.
Keturah—Abraham’s concubine—had Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, Shuah. Jokshan’s sons; Sheba, Dedan.
Midian’s crew; Ephah, Epher, Henoch, Abida, Eldaah. All Keturah’s line.
Abraham had Isaac. Isaac had Esau and Israel.
Esau’s sons; Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jaalam, Korah.
Eliphaz’s boys; Teman, Omar, Zephi, Gatam, Kenaz, Timna, Amalek.
Reuel’s sons; Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, Mizzah.
Seir’s sons; Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer, Dishan.
Lotan’s sons; Hori, Homam. Sis was Timna.
Shobal’s sons; Alian, Manahath, Ebal, Shephi, Onam. Zibeon’s sons; Aiah, Anah.
Anah’s son; Dishon. Dishon’s crew; Amram, Eshban, Ithran, Cheran.
Ezer’s sons; Bilhan, Zavan, Jakan. Dishan’s sons; Uz, Aran.
Kings in Edom pre-Israel crown drop; Bela, son of Beor. City: Dinhabah.
Bela dipped. Jobab, Zerah’s son from Bozrah, took throne.
Jobab dipped. Husham from Temani land ruled.
Husham dipped. Hadad, son of Bedad, clapped Midian in Moab. City: Avith.
Hadad dipped. Samlah from Masrekah ruled.
Samlah dipped. Shaul from Rehoboth by the river ruled.
Shaul dipped. Baalhanan, son of Achbor, ruled.
Baalhanan dipped. Hadad ruled. City: Pau. His girl: Mehetabel, daughter of Matred, daughter of Mezahab.
Hadad dipped. Edom’s dukes; Timnah, Aliah, Jetheth,
Aholibamah, Elah, Pinon,
Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar,
Magdiel, Iram. These are the dukes of Edom.
Israel’s sons: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun,
Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, Asher.
Judah’s boys: Er, Onan, Shelah—those three came from Shua’s daughter, a Canaanite. Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wildin’—God took him out.
Tamar, his daughter-in-law, had Pharez and Zerah. Judah’s total sons: five.
Pharez’s line: Hezron, Hamul.
Zerah’s sons: Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol, Dara. Squad of five.
Carmi’s son: Achar—the one who brought chaos to Israel, touched cursed loot.
Ethan’s son: Azariah.
Hezron’s sons: Jerahmeel, Ram, Chelubai.
Ram had Amminadab. Amminadab had Nahshon—he led Judah’s crew.
Nahshon had Salma. Salma had Boaz.
Boaz had Obed. Obed had Jesse.
Jesse’s sons: Eliab the firstborn, Abinadab second, Shimea third,
Nethaneel fourth, Raddai fifth,
Ozem sixth, David seventh.
Their sisters: Zeruiah, Abigail. Zeruiah’s sons: Abishai, Joab, Asahel—trio of hitters.
Abigail had Amasa. Amasa’s dad: Jether the Ishmeelite.
Caleb (Hezron’s son) had Azubah and Jerioth. Azubah’s son: Jesher, Shobab, Ardon.
Azubah died. Caleb married Ephrath—she had Hur.
Hur had Uri. Uri had Bezaleel.
Hezron bagged a wife at sixty from Machir’s fam (Gilead’s dad). She had Segub.
Segub had Jair—he ran twenty-three towns in Gilead.
Geshur and Aram snatched Jair’s towns, plus Kenath and its hoods—sixty cities. All that was Machir’s turf.
Hezron died in Caleb-ephratah. Abiah, his wife, had Ashur—he built Tekoa.
Jerahmeel’s sons: Ram the firstborn, Bunah, Oren, Ozem, Ahijah.
Jerahmeel had another wife, Atarah—she had Onam.
Ram’s sons: Maaz, Jamin, Eker.
Onam’s sons: Shammai, Jada. Shammai’s sons: Nadab, Abishur.
Abishur’s wife: Abihail. She had Ahban, Molid.
Nadab’s sons: Seled, Appaim. Seled died no kids.
Appaim had Ishi. Ishi had Sheshan. Sheshan had Ahlai.
Jada’s bros: Jether, Jonathan. Jether died no kids.
Jonathan’s sons: Peleth, Zaza. That’s Jerahmeel’s line.
Sheshan had no sons, just daughters. He gave his daughter to Jarha (his Egyptian servant)—they had Attai.
Attai had Nathan. Nathan had Zabad.
Zabad had Ephlal. Ephlal had Obed.
Obed had Jehu. Jehu had Azariah.
Azariah had Helez. Helez had Eleasah.
Eleasah had Sisamai. Sisamai had Shallum.
Shallum had Jekamiah. Jekamiah had Elishama.
Caleb’s bro Sheshan had Mesha (firstborn), dad of Ziph. Ziph’s son: Mareshah, who built Hebron.
Caleb’s sons: Mesha (Ziph’s dad), Mareshah (Hebron’s dad).
Hebron’s sons: Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, Shema.
Shema had Raham (Jorkoam’s dad). Rekem had Shammai.
Shammai’s son: Maon. Maon built Beth-zur.
Caleb’s side girl Ephah had Haran, Moza, Gazez. Haran had Gazez.
Jahdai’s sons: Regem, Jotham, Gesham, Pelet, Ephah, Shaaph.
Caleb’s other girl Maachah had Sheber, Tirhanah.
She also had Shaaph (Madmannah’s dad), Sheva (Machbenah and Gibea’s dad). Caleb’s daughter: Achsa.
These were Caleb’s sons (Hur’s line): Shobal (Kirjath-jearim’s boss),
Salma (Bethlehem’s boss), Hareph (Beth-gader’s boss).
Shobal’s sons: Haroeh, half of Manaheth’s crew.
Kirjath-jearim’s fam: Ithrites, Puhites, Shumathites, Mishraites. From them came Zareathites, Eshtaulites.
Salma’s sons: Bethlehem, Netophathites, Ataroth’s scribes,
Jabez’s fam: Tirathites, Shimeathites, Suchathites. These were Kenites from Hammath—fam of Rechab’s scribes.
David’s sons born in Hebron: Amnon (Ahinoam from Jezreel), Daniel (Abigail from Carmel),
Absalom (Maacah, daughter of Talmai, king of Geshur), Adonijah (Haggith),
Shephatiah (Abital), Ithream (Eglah, David’s wifey).
Six sons in Hebron. David ruled there seven years and six months. Then he reigned thirty-three years in Jerusalem.
In Jerusalem he had: Shimea, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon—Bathshua (Ammiel’s daughter) was their mom.
Ibhar, Elishama, Eliphelet,
Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,
Elishama, Eliada, Eliphelet—nine total.
All sons of David, plus sons from side queens. Tamar was their sis.
Solomon’s line: Rehoboam, Abia his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,
Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,
Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,
Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,
Amon his son, Josiah his son.
Josiah’s sons: firstborn Johanan, second Jehoiakim, third Zedekiah, fourth Shallum.
Jehoiakim’s sons: Jeconiah, Zedekiah.
Sons of Jeconiah (the captive): Salathiel his son,
Malchiram, Pedaiah, Shenazar, Jecamiah, Hoshama, Nedabiah.
Pedaiah’s sons: Zerubbabel, Shimei. Zerubbabel’s sons: Meshullam, Hananiah. Their sis: Shelomith.
Hashubah, Ohel, Berechiah, Hasadiah, Jushabhesed—five more from Zerubbabel.
Hananiah’s sons: Pelatiah, Jesaiah. His line: Rephaiah, Arnan, Obadiah, Shechaniah.
Shechaniah’s son: Shemaiah. Shemaiah’s sons: Hattush, Igeal, Bariah, Neariah, Shaphat—five total.
Neariah’s sons: Elioenai, Hezekiah, Azrikam—three.
Elioenai’s sons: Hodaiah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Dalaiah, Anani—seven deep.
Judah’s line: Pharez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, Shobal.
Shobal’s son: Reaiah. Reaiah had Jahath. Jahath had Ahumai and Lahad. That’s the Zorathite fam.
Etam’s crew: Jezreel, Ishma, Idbash. Sis was Hazelelponi.
Penuel ran Gedor. Ezer ran Hushah. All Hur’s sons—he was Ephratah’s firstborn, Bethlehem’s OG.
Ashur (Tekoa’s founder) had two wives: Helah and Naarah.
Naarah’s sons: Ahuzam, Hepher, Temeni, Haahashtari. That’s her full drop.
Helah’s sons: Zereth, Jezoar, Ethnan.
Coz had Anub, Zobebah, and the fam of Aharhel (Harum’s son).
Jabez stood out—more solid than his bros. His mom named him Jabez (‘cause she birthed him in pain).
Jabez prayed up: “God, bless me big. Expand my turf. Stay close. Keep me from pain.” And God said bet.
Chelub (Shuhah’s bro) had Mehir. Mehir had Eshton.
Eshton had Bethrapha, Paseah, Tehinnah (Irnahash’s dad). These were Recah’s boys.
Kenaz’s sons: Othniel, Seraiah. Othniel’s son: Hathath.
Meonothai had Ophrah. Seraiah had Joab (founder of Geharashim—toolsmith town).
Caleb’s son Jephunneh had Iru, Elah, Naam. Elah’s son: Kenaz.
Jehaleleel’s sons: Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria, Asareel.
Ezrah’s sons: Jether, Mered, Epher, Jalon. Mered’s wife (Pharaoh’s daughter Bithiah) had Miriam, Shammai, Ishbah (Eshtemoa’s dad).
His Judahite wife had Jered (Gedor’s dad), Heber (Socho’s dad), Jekuthiel (Zanoah’s dad). All from Bithiah.
Hodiah’s wife (Naham’s sis) had Keilah’s crew (Garmite blood) and Eshtemoa’s fam (Maachathite line).
Shimon’s sons: Amnon, Rinnah, Benhanan, Tilon. Ishi’s sons: Zoheth, Benzoheth.
Judah’s son Shelah had Er (Lecah’s dad), Laadah (Mareshah’s dad), fam of linen workers in Bethashbea,
Jokim, Cozeba’s men, Joash, Saraph (ran Moab and Jashubi-lehem). These are throwback records.
They were potters, chillin’ in Netaim and Gederah, locked in with the king’s grind.
Simeon’s sons: Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, Shaul.
Shaul’s son: Shallum. Shallum had Mibsam. Mibsam had Mishma.
Mishma had Hamuel. Hamuel had Zacchur. Zacchur had Shimei.
Shimei had sixteen sons, six daughters. But his bros? No big fams.
They lived in Beersheba, Moladah, Hazarshual,
Bilhah, Ezem, Tolad,
Bethuel, Hormah, Ziklag,
Bethmarcaboth, Hazarsusim, Bethbirei, Shaaraim. These were their cities till David’s reign.
Also Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Tochen, Ashan—five towns,
Plus all the hoods around these cities, up to Baal. That’s their map. They had receipts.
Meshobab, Jamlech, Joshah (Amaziah’s son),
Joel, Jehu (Josibiah’s son, Seriah’s son, Asiel’s son),
Elioenai, Jaakobah, Jeshohaiah, Asaiah, Adiel, Jesimiel, Benaiah,
Ziza (Shiphi’s son, Allon’s son, Jedaiah’s son, Shimri’s son, Shemaiah’s son).
These were name-brand chiefs. Their fams blew up.
They rolled to Gerar’s edge, east to the valley, hunting more land.
Found green pastures, chill vibes, wide open. Peaceful folks, no ops.
These listed names came thru in Hezekiah’s era, clapped the tents, wiped ‘em out. Took the land. Lived there ‘cause it was vibes.
Some Simeon boys—five hundred deep—rolled to Seir’s hill zone. Led by Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah, Uzziel’s sons.
They smoked the Amalekite leftovers, held it down, and still camped there.
Reuben, Israel’s firstborn—he was supposed to be the heir, but he fumbled hard and slept with his dad’s girl. So the birthright got passed to Joseph’s sons. Reuben ain’t get the crown.
Judah had main character energy—his line got the throne. But the birthright? Still Joseph’s.
Reuben’s sons: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, Carmi.
Joel was Reuben’s son. Joel had Shemaiah. Shemaiah had Gog. Gog had Shimei.
Shimei had Micah. Micah had Reaia. Reaia had Baal.
Baal had Beerah—he got snatched by Tilgathpilneser (Assyria’s king) when he was repping Reuben.
Reuben’s fam tree: his bros by clans, listed by names, heads, and squads. Main guy: Jeiel. Others: Zechariah,
Bela (Azaz’s son, Shema’s son, Joel’s son). They lived in Aroer, up to Nebo and Baalmeon.
They spread east to Euphrates—had mad cattle in Gilead.
In Saul’s days, they clapped the Hagarites and took their turf across the land.
Gad’s crew lived next to Reuben in Bashan, all the way to Salcah.
Joel was top dog. Shapham was second. Janai and Shaphat held it down in Bashan.
Their squad: Michael, Meshullam, Sheba, Jorai, Jachan, Zia, Heber—seven deep.
These were sons of Abihail, son of Huri, son of Jaroah, son of Gilead, son of Michael, son of Jeshishai, son of Jahdo, son of Buz.
Ahi (Abdiel’s son, Guni’s son) was the clan boss.
They lived in Gilead, Bashan, Sharon, and all the ‘burbs.
All this was locked in during Jotham’s reign in Judah and Jeroboam’s in Israel.
Reuben, Gad, and half of Manasseh rolled 44,760 deep—squad full of warriors, shielded, sworded, bow-ready, trained to throw down.
They went to war with the Hagarites—Jetur, Nephish, Nodab.
They cried to God mid-battle, and He came thru ‘cause they trusted Him.
They took the Hagarites’ Ls: camels (fifty thou), sheep (two-fifty thou), donkeys (two thou), and a hundred thou people.
Many got dropped—God was in the mix. They lived in that land ‘til exile.
Half of Manasseh’s crew lived in Bashan, Baalhermon, Senir, Mount Hermon—they were stacked.
Heads of fam: Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, Jahdiel—solid dudes, famous, squad leaders.
But they switched up—cheated on God, chased the gods of the people He clapped.
So God stirred up Pul (Assyria’s king) and Tilgathpilneser. They got exiled—Reuben, Gad, and half Manasseh got dragged to Halah, Habor, Hara, and Gozan’s river. Still there.
Levi’s sons: Gershon, Kohath, Merari.
Kohath’s sons: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, Uzziel.
Amram’s kids: Aaron, Moses, Miriam. Aaron’s sons: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, Ithamar.
Eleazar had Phinehas. Phinehas had Abishua.
Abishua had Bukki. Bukki had Uzzi.
Uzzi had Zerahiah. Zerahiah had Meraioth.
Meraioth had Amariah. Amariah had Ahitub.
Ahitub had Zadok. Zadok had Ahimaaz.
Ahimaaz had Azariah. Azariah had Johanan.
Johanan had Azariah—he ran the priest ops in Solomon’s temple.
Azariah had Amariah. Amariah had Ahitub.
Ahitub had Zadok. Zadok had Shallum.
Shallum had Hilkiah. Hilkiah had Azariah.
Azariah had Seraiah. Seraiah had Jehozadak.
Jehozadak got exiled when the Lord sent Judah and Jerusalem to Babylon by Nebuchadnezzar.
Levi’s sons: Gershom, Kohath, Merari.
Gershom’s sons: Libni, Shimei.
Kohath’s sons: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, Uzziel.
Merari’s sons: Mahli, Mushi. These are Levi’s fams by name.
Gershom’s line: Libni, Jahath, Zimmah,
Joah, Iddo, Zerah, Jeaterai.
Kohath’s line: Amminadab, Korah, Assir,
Elkanah, Ebiasaph, Assir,
Tahath, Uriel, Uzziah, Shaul.
Elkanah’s sons: Amasai, Ahimoth.
Elkanah, Zophai, Nahath,
Eliab, Jeroham, Elkanah.
Samuel’s sons: Joel the firstborn, Abiah the second.
Merari’s line: Mahli, Libni, Shimei, Uzza,
Shimea, Haggiah, Asaiah.
These are the ones David set over the music when the ark got parked.
They served with songs before the tabernacle got a house.
These are the singers: sons of Kohath—Heman the chief, son of Joel, son of Samuel,
Son of Elkanah, son of Jeroham, son of Eliel, son of Toah,
Son of Zuph, son of Elkanah, son of Mahath, son of Amasai,
Son of Elkanah, son of Joel, son of Azariah, son of Zephaniah,
Son of Tahath, son of Assir, son of Ebiasaph, son of Korah,
Son of Izhar, son of Kohath, son of Levi, son of Israel.
Heman’s bro Asaph stood on his right—Asaph was Berachiah’s son, Shimea’s son,
Michael’s son, Baaseiah’s son, Malchiah’s son,
Ethni’s son, Zerah’s son, Adaiah’s son,
Ethan’s son, Zimmah’s son, Shimei’s son,
Jahath’s son, Gershom’s son, Levi’s son.
On the left: their bros, Merari’s sons—Ethan the son of Kishi, son of Abdi, son of Malluch,
Son of Hashabiah, son of Amaziah, son of Hilkiah,
Son of Amzi, son of Bani, son of Shamer,
Son of Mahli, son of Mushi, son of Merari, son of Levi.
Their bros the Levites were set to handle the Lord’s house.
Aaron and his sons burned offerings, ran the temple, and made atonement for Israel.
Aaron’s line: Eleazar, Phinehas, Abishua,
Bukki, Uzzi, Zerahiah,
Meraioth, Amariah, Ahitub,
Zadok, Ahimaaz.
This the drop for the sons of Aaron, the priest fam from Kohath:
They gave ‘em Hebron in Judah, with the ‘burbs around it.
But the fields and villages? That went to Caleb’s fam (Jephunneh’s line).
To the sons of Aaron: cities of refuge—Hebron, Libnah with suburbs,
Jattir, Eshtemoa with suburbs,
Hilen, Debir with suburbs,
Ashan, Bethshemesh with suburbs. From Benjamin: Geba, Alemeth, Anathoth with suburbs. Thirteen cities total.
The rest of Kohath’s sons got ten cities by lot from Ephraim’s tribe.
Gershom’s crew got thirteen cities from Issachar, Asher, Naphtali, and Manasseh in Bashan.
Merari’s fam got twelve cities by lot from Reuben, Gad, Zebulun.
Israel gave these cities and suburbs to the Levites.
They gave by lot from Judah, Simeon, Benjamin—these cities got named earlier.
Some Kohathite clans got cities from Ephraim’s tribe.
They gave ‘em Shechem (refuge city) in mount Ephraim, Gezer with suburbs,
Jokmeam, Bethhoron with suburbs,
Aijalon, Gathrimmon with suburbs.
From half Manasseh: Aner, Bileam with suburbs—for the rest of Kohath’s line.
Gershom’s sons got Golan in Bashan, Ashtaroth with suburbs from half Manasseh.
From Issachar: Kedesh, Daberath with suburbs,
Ramoth, Anem with suburbs.
From Asher: Mashal, Abdon with suburbs,
Hukok, Rehob with suburbs.
From Naphtali: Kedesh in Galilee, Hammon, Kirjathaim with suburbs.
Merari’s sons got from Zebulun: Rimmon, Tabor with suburbs.
From Reuben (east of Jordan, Jericho side): Bezer in the wilderness, Jahzah with suburbs,
Kedemoth, Mephaath with suburbs.
From Gad: Ramoth in Gilead, Mahanaim with suburbs,
Heshbon, Jazer with suburbs.
Issachar’s sons: Tola, Puah, Jashub, Shimron—four deep.
Tola’s sons: Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Jibsam, Shemuel—heads of fams, Tola’s line. All warriors. In David’s day: 22,600.
Uzzi’s son: Izrahiah. Izrahiah’s sons: Michael, Obadiah, Joel, Ishiah—five chiefs.
With them: 36,000 soldiers, squad built from big fams.
Issachar’s whole tribe: 87,000 warriors, all verified by scroll.
Benjamin’s sons: Bela, Becher, Jediael—three.
Bela’s sons: Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth, Iri—five chiefs. Scroll count: 22,034.
Becher’s sons: Zemira, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jerimoth, Abiah, Anathoth, Alameth. All sons of Becher.
Scroll count: 20,200 warriors, all fam heads.
Jediael’s son: Bilhan. Bilhan’s sons: Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Chenaanah, Zethan, Tharshish, Ahishahar.
All sons of Jediael: 17,200 warriors, ready for battle.
Shuppim and Huppim were Ir’s sons. Hushim was Aher’s son.
Naphtali’s sons: Jahziel, Guni, Jezer, Shallum—Bilhah’s line.
Manasseh’s sons (via his Aramitess side chick): Ashriel (firstborn). She also had Machir (Gilead’s dad).
Machir got a wife from Huppim and Shuppim’s fam. Sis’s name: Maachah. Second son: Zelophehad—he had only daughters.
Maachah (Machir’s wife) had Peresh, Sheresh. Peresh’s sons: Ulam, Rakem.
Ulam’s son: Bedan. That’s Gilead’s line (Machir’s son, Manasseh’s son).
Gilead’s sis Hammoleketh had Ishod, Abiezer, Mahalah.
Shemida’s sons: Ahian, Shechem, Likhi, Aniam.
Ephraim’s sons: Shuthelah, Bered, Tahath, Eladah, Tahath,
Zabad, Shuthelah. Ezer and Elead got clapped by Gath locals ‘cause they tried to jack cattle.
Ephraim mourned hard. Fam pulled up to comfort him.
He went in to his wife again. She had a son. He named him Beriah (‘cause disaster hit).
His daughter: Sherah—she built Lower and Upper Bethhoron, and Uzzen-sherah.
Beriah’s son: Rephah. Then Resheph, Telah, Tahan,
Laadan, Ammihud, Elishama,
Non, Joshua.
Their land: Bethel and nearby towns, east to Naaran, west to Gezer and its towns. Shechem and its towns, Gaza and its towns.
By Manasseh’s side: Bethshean, Taanach, Megiddo, Dor—all with towns. These were Joseph’s sons’ turf.
Asher’s sons: Imnah, Ishuah, Ishui, Beriah, their sis Serah.
Beriah’s sons: Heber, Malchiel (he built Birzavith).
Heber had Japhlet, Shomer, Hotham, their sis Shua.
Japhlet’s sons: Pasach, Bimhal, Ashvath.
Shomer’s sons: Ahi, Rohgah, Jehubbah, Aram.
Hotham’s sons: Zophah, Imna, Shelesh, Amal.
Zophah’s sons: Suah, Harnepher, Shual, Beri, Imrah,
Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilshah, Ithran, Beera.
Jether’s sons: Jephunneh, Pispah, Ara.
Ulla’s sons: Arah, Haniel, Rezia.
All these were Asher’s sons—fam heads, elite warriors, top-tier chiefs. Scroll count: 26,000 battle-ready men.
Benjamin’s firstborn: Bela. Then Ashbel, Aharah,
Nohah, Rapha—five sons total.
Bela’s sons: Addar, Gera, Abihud,
Abishua, Naaman, Ahoah,
Gera, Shephuphan, Huram.
Ehud’s sons (they ran Geba, got exiled to Manahath):
Naaman, Ahiah, Gera—he led the exile. He had Uzza, Ahihud.
Shaharaim dropped kids in Moab after he dipped from Hushim and Baara his wives.
He had Hodesh later—she had Jobab, Zibia, Mesha, Malcham,
Jeuz, Shachia, Mirma. All chiefs, sons of Hodesh.
Hushim had Abitub, Elpaal.
Elpaal’s sons: Eber, Misham, Shamed (he built Ono, Lod, and their towns),
Beriah, Shema (chiefs in Aijalon—they clapped Gath’s ops),
Ahio, Shashak, Jeremoth,
Zebadiah, Arad, Ader,
Michael, Ispah, Joha—sons of Beriah.

Ulam’s sons were elite archers—many sons, grandsons, 150 total. All these were Benjamin’s fam.
All Israel got counted, locked in scrolls. They got exiled to Babylon for wildin’ on God.
First wave back home: priests, Levites, Nethinims.
Folks from Judah, Benjamin, Ephraim, Manasseh pulled up to Jerusalem.

Gatekeepers: Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman, and bros. Shallum was chief.
He held the east gate since the king’s day.
Shallum (Kore’s son, Ebiasaph’s son, Korah’s line) and his fam ran the gates—tabernacle guards, like their ancestors.
Phinehas (Eleazar’s son) was their OG leader—God was with him.
Zechariah was gatekeeper at the tabernacle’s door.
All gatekeepers: 212. Scroll-certified by fam. David and Samuel the seer set them up.
They held it down at the Lord’s house gates.
Four sides: east, west, north, south—gatekeepers posted.
Their squad rotated weekly from their towns.
Four chiefs stayed full-time—they were Levites, over the chambers and treasures.
They camped near God’s house, had key duty, opened every morning.
Some watched the gear—counted it in and out.
Others managed the tools, holy stuff, flour, wine, oil, incense, spices.
Some priests mixed the incense.
Mattithiah (Levite, firstborn of Shallum the Korahite) handled baking.
Kohathites’ bros prepped the showbread every Sabbath.
These were the singers—Levites, free from other duties, full-time booth duty.
These were the Levite chiefs, fam heads, locked in Jerusalem.

Philistines pulled up on Israel. Israel dipped—bodies dropped all over Mount Gilboa.
Philistines chased Saul and his sons. They clapped Jonathan, Abinadab, Malchishua—Saul’s boys.
The heat was heavy on Saul. Archers locked in—he got hit bad.
Saul told his armor bearer, “Run me through. Don’t let these uncircumcised ops flex on me.” But the dude froze. So Saul took the blade and fell on it.
Armor bearer saw Saul was gone—he dropped himself too.
Saul, his three sons, and his whole house—wiped out same day.
Israel’s squad saw the king dead, dipped out the cities. Philistines moved in.
Next day, Philistines came to loot bodies—found Saul and his sons laid out on Gilboa.
They stripped him, took his head and armor, sent messengers flexing in their temples and to the people.
They dropped his armor in their god’s house, stuck his skull in Dagon’s temple.
Jabeshgilead heard what went down with Saul.
All their warriors rolled out, grabbed the bodies of Saul and his sons, brought them back to Jabesh, buried the bones under the oak, fasted seven days.
Saul died ‘cause he wilded out—broke God’s word, didn’t listen, even tried to tap the dead for answers.
He didn’t seek God, so God ended him, passed the crown to David, Jesse’s son.
